content:
Since each starting point gives a length-3 word of consecutive colors, and these \(n\) words must all be distinct, we need \(n \le 2^3 = 8\).

This bound is achievable: color the 8 points cyclically as  
\[
00010111
\]
(where \(0=\) red, \(1=\) blue). Its cyclic length-3 substrings are
\[
000,001,010,101,011,111,110,100,
\]
which are all 8 possible binary 3-words.

Thus the maximum number of points is

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
